blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte came under sustained questioning from the prosecution on Tuesday over 19 city government contracts worth P33.2 million that were awarded to GenCorp Industries Inc., a company listed by his sister, Vice President Sara Duterte, as a business interest in her statement of assets, liabilities and net […]...
